SELECT 
    rc.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    main.risk_classification rc
JOIN 
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.grade_name_en = 'Substandard'
ORDER BY 
    rc.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE 
    ptc.name_zh = '现金支取'
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM 
    main.party p
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
WHERE 
    op.registered_region = (
        SELECT 
            ou.region_code
        FROM 
            main.organization_unit ou
        WHERE 
            ou.unit_name = '上海分行'
    )
    AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
ORDER BY 
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ic.sector_name_zh,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ic ON op.industry_code = ic.sector_code
GROUP BY 
    ic.sector_code, ic.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.fair_value) AS total_market_value
FROM 
    main.wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN 
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(abs.ledger_balance) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    main.account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM 
    delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY 
    avg_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) AS total_exposure,
    (SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS exposure_ratio
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = lbs.loan_id)
    AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id)
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(l.loan_id) AS npl_ratio
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    main.industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
JOIN 
    main.risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.risk_classification WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_code, i.sector_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG(management_fee_rate) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS "担保人编号",
    p.display_name AS "担保人名称",
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS "在保余额合计"
FROM 
    main.guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    main.party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to >= DATE('now'))
GROUP BY 
    gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    SUM(d.observed_value) AS total_observed_value
FROM 
    data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN 
    institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM 
    main.regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    overdue_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    d.loan_id,
    d.principal_overdue_days,
    rc.grade_code,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    main.delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN 
    main.risk_classification rc ON d.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE 
    d.principal_overdue_days > 90
    AND rc.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
ORDER BY 
    d.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    main.industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND i.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN ind.sector_name_en IN ('Restricted', 'Exit') THEN pi.instruction_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS non_compliant_amount,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS total_instruction_amount,
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN ind.sector_name_en IN ('Restricted', 'Exit') THEN pi.instruction_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS ratio
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind ON ca.target_industry_code = ind.sector_code
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    ma.maturity_on IS NOT NULL 
    AND wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL
    AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY 
    ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name
FROM 
    main.payment_event pe
JOIN 
    main.payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN 
    main.organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000.0
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    op.industry_code AS borrower_registered_industry,
    ca.target_industry_code AS agreement_target_industry,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
WHERE 
    ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    ph_from.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    ph_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM 
    main.payment_event pe
JOIN 
    main.account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN 
    main.account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah_from ON acc_from.account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah_to ON acc_to.account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    main.party ph_from ON ah_from.party_id = ph_from.party_id
JOIN 
    main.party ph_to ON ah_to.party_id = ph_to.party_id
JOIN 
    main.party_relation pr ON (ph_from.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND ph_to.party_id = pr.target_party_id) 
                           OR (ph_from.party_id = pr.target_party_id AND ph_to.party_id = pr.source_party_id)
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1 
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    staff_member sm
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON sm.home_org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
JOIN 
    account acc ON pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id 
    AND ah.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY 
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    cdd.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cdd.event_date,
    cdd.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN 
    institution i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cdd.event_date <= '2026-06-30'
    AND cdd.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    days_overdue DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    cl.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    so.covered_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (so.effective_to IS NULL OR so.effective_to > datetime('now'))
ORDER BY 
    so.covered_amount DESC;

WITH LoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, l.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rank_in_institution
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown l ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = l.loan_id
    )
),
MaxLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        institution_name,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        rank_in_institution
    FROM LoanBalances
    WHERE rank_in_institution = 1
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rank_in_institution
FROM MaxLoans
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    sec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sec.sector_code ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS rank_in_industry
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector sec ON op.industry_code = sec.sector_code
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
ORDER BY 
    sec.sector_name_zh ASC,
    rank_in_industry ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    avg_bal.avg_principal_balance,
    (lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_principal_balance) AS excess_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ca_inner.institution_id,
            AVG(lbs_inner.principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown ld_inner
        JOIN 
            loan_balance_snapshot lbs_inner ON ld_inner.loan_id = lbs_inner.loan_id
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement ca_inner ON ld_inner.agreement_id = ca_inner.agreement_id
        GROUP BY 
            ca_inner.institution_id
    ) avg_bal ON ca.institution_id = avg_bal.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.principal_balance > avg_bal.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY 
    excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.collateral_id) = 0
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END AS interval_start,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot
GROUP BY interval_start
ORDER BY interval_start ASC;

SELECT 
    collateral_id,
    valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM 
    collateral_valuation
GROUP BY 
    collateral_id, 
    valued_on
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY 
    collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    AVG(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 AS avg_single_loan_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON p.party_id = (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ca.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id 
        WHERE ld2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id
ORDER BY 
    avg_single_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    AVG(per.annual_income) AS average_annual_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN per.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS high_income_ratio
FROM 
    main.party p
JOIN 
    main.person_profile per ON p.party_id = per.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH payment_with_parties AS (
    SELECT 
        p.payment_id,
        p.from_account_id,
        p.to_account_id,
        p.amount,
        p.origin_org_unit_id,
        ah_from.account_id AS from_account_id_check,
        ah_from.party_id AS from_party_id,
        ah_to.account_id AS to_account_id_check,
        ah_to.party_id AS to_party_id,
        COALESCE(acc_from.institution_id, acc_to.institution_id) AS inst_id
    FROM main.payment_event p
    JOIN main.account_holder ah_from ON p.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    JOIN main.account_holder ah_to ON p.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    JOIN main.account acc_from ON p.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
    JOIN main.account acc_to ON p.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
),
related_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        pwp.payment_id,
        pwp.amount,
        pwp.inst_id,
        i.institution_name
    FROM payment_with_parties pwp
    JOIN main.party_relation pr 
        ON pwp.from_party_id = pr.source_party_id 
        AND pwp.to_party_id = pr.target_party_id
        AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    JOIN main.institution i ON pwp.inst_id = i.institution_id
),
total_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        inst_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM payment_with_parties
    GROUP BY inst_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS "机构名称",
    COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount), 0) AS "关联方交易金额",
    tp.total_amount AS "全部交易金额",
    (COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount), 0) * 1.0 / tp.total_amount) AS "占比"
FROM main.institution i
JOIN total_payments tp ON i.institution_id = tp.inst_id
LEFT JOIN related_payments rp ON i.institution_id = rp.inst_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, tp.total_amount
ORDER BY "占比" DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.card_type = 'CREDIT' THEN pc.card_id END) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM 
    main.party p
JOIN 
    main.payment_card pc ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN 
    main.account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    main.term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.card_type = 'CREDIT' THEN pc.card_id END) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    term_deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(JULIANDAY('2026-06-30') - JULIANDAY(ld.disbursed_on)) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ld.disbursed_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    avg_loan_age_days DESC;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        op.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
    GROUP BY op.industry_code
),
industry_with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_code,
        total_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC) AS cumulative_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM industry_loan_balances
),
industry_cumulative_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_code,
        total_balance,
        (cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total) AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM industry_with_cumulative
)
SELECT 
    icr.industry_code AS industry_name,
    icr.total_balance,
    icr.cumulative_ratio
FROM industry_cumulative_ratio icr
WHERE icr.cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY icr.cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    i.institution_name AS institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS outstanding_loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.status != 'CLOSED'
    AND ld.closed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, i.institution_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    outstanding_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cv.valuation_amount = (
        SELECT MAX(cv_inner.valuation_amount)
        FROM collateral_valuation cv_inner
        WHERE cv_inner.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    )
    AND cv.valuation_amount > (so.covered_amount * 2.0)
ORDER BY 
    (cv.valuation_amount - so.covered_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN 
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND a.institution_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY 
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT from_account_id AS account_id, business_date AS transaction_date, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event
WHERE from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(re.gross_exposure, 0)) AS total_loan_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN 
    risk_exposure re ON egm.party_id = re.obligor_party_id 
                     AND eg.institution_id = re.institution_id
                     AND re.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    COUNT(*) AS guarantee_contract_count,
    SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment g
JOIN 
    party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1 
    AND SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000.0
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
    AND julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) >= 90
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount,
    pp.display_name AS payee_name
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.party pp ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
    AND ca.borrower_party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND p.status = 'FROZEN'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    is.sector_name_zh,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_family OR lpc.product_code = (SELECT product_code FROM main.loan_product_catalog WHERE is_working_capital = 1 LIMIT 1)
JOIN 
    main.industry_sector is ON ca.target_industry_code = is.sector_code
WHERE 
    lpc.is_working_capital = 1
    AND is.risk_category = 'EXIT'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        AVG(lbs.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id) AS avg_institution_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
),
filtered_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        lb.avg_institution_balance,
        (lb.principal_balance - lb.avg_institution_balance) AS excess_amount
    FROM loan_balances lb
    JOIN institution i ON lb.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE lb.principal_balance > 2.0 * lb.avg_institution_balance
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    avg_institution_balance,
    excess_amount
FROM filtered_loans
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

WITH all_agreements AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
),
non_related_agreements AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN main.party_relation pr ON ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id 
        AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    WHERE pr.relation_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    aa.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0.0) AS non_related_amount,
    aa.total_amount,
    (COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / aa.total_amount) AS ratio
FROM all_agreements aa
LEFT JOIN non_related_agreements nra ON aa.institution_id = nra.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    c.net_capital,
    (SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / c.net_capital) AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.capital_snapshot c ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, p.party_id
HAVING 
    concentration_ratio > 0.10
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        target_industry_code,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM main.credit_agreement
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS execution_rate,
    ia.avg_rate AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate, 2) AS markup_percent
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_avg ia ON ca.target_industry_code = ia.target_industry_code
WHERE (ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate > 10.0
ORDER BY markup_percent DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS excess_customer_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot 
        WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
    AND lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    AND lbs.principal_balance > (cs.net_capital * 0.10)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    excess_customer_count DESC;

WITH group_exposures AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_balance
    FROM main.exposure_group eg
    JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE eg.group_type = 'GROUP_CUSTOMER'
      AND eg.effective_to IS NULL
      AND egm.effective_to IS NULL
      AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
capital_data AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM main.capital_snapshot
    WHERE currency_code = 'CNY'
      AND as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
          FROM main.capital_snapshot cs2 
          WHERE cs2.institution_id = main.capital_snapshot.institution_id
      )
)
SELECT 
    ge.exposure_group_id,
    ge.group_name,
    ge.total_balance,
    cd.net_capital,
    (ge.total_balance * 1.0 / cd.net_capital) AS concentration_ratio
FROM group_exposures ge
JOIN capital_data cd ON ge.institution_id = cd.institution_id
WHERE (ge.total_balance * 1.0 / cd.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'MATURED'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_between
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON ld.disbursement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE 
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
    AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) >= 0
ORDER BY 
    days_between ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        p.party_id,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) AS total_loan_principal
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.party_type = p.party_type
    WHERE ptc.name_zh = '对公客户'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id 
        JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ca2.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id 
        WHERE ca2.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name
),
capital_data AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        MAX(as_of_date) AS latest_date,
        MAX(net_capital) AS net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        le.institution_name,
        le.customer_name,
        le.total_loan_principal,
        cd.net_capital,
        (le.total_loan_principal * 1.0 / NULLIF(cd.net_capital, 0)) AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY le.institution_id ORDER BY (le.total_loan_principal * 1.0 / NULLIF(cd.net_capital, 0)) DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_exposure le
    JOIN capital_data cd ON cd.institution_id = le.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    ratio
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
FROM (
    SELECT 
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        i.institution_id
    FROM main.loan_drawdown l
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot)
) sub
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 100.0 / inst_total.total_balance, 2) AS ratio_percent
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown l
JOIN 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ca2.institution_id,
            SUM(lbs2.principal_balance) AS total_balance
        FROM 
            main.loan_drawdown ld2
        JOIN 
            main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
        JOIN 
            main.credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
        GROUP BY 
            ca2.institution_id
    ) inst_total ON i.institution_id = inst_total.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    i.institution_name ASC,
    ratio_percent DESC,
    l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    SUM(ls.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal,
    COUNT(ls.loan_id) AS overdue_period_count
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ls.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING 
    COUNT(ls.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    overdue_period_count DESC, 
    total_overdue_principal DESC, 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    disbursement_account_id,
    disbursed_on,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown
GROUP BY 
    disbursement_account_id,
    disbursed_on
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
FROM main.account_holder ah
JOIN main.term_deposit td ON ah.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY ah.party_id ASC;

SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN staff_member sm ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM main.account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
      SELECT p.from_account_id
      FROM main.payment_event p
      JOIN main.payment_type_catalog plc ON p.payment_type = plc.payment_type
      WHERE plc.name_zh = '现金支取'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    security_id,
    guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    main.guarantor_commitment
WHERE 
    status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY 
    guaranteed_amount DESC;

WITH loan_maturity AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.current_maturity_on,
        CAST(julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') AS INTEGER) AS days_remaining
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
),
categorized_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN days_remaining < 0 THEN '已到期'
            WHEN days_remaining >= 0 AND days_remaining <= 90 THEN '临期'
            ELSE '常态'
        END AS bucket
    FROM loan_maturity
)
SELECT 
    bucket AS "档位",
    COUNT(*) AS "笔数"
FROM categorized_loans
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY 
    CASE bucket 
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1 
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2 
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3 
    END;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS association_count
FROM 
    main.collateral_link cl
JOIN 
    main.security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY 
    association_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_type,
    AVG(cv.valuation_amount) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM 
    main.collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    main.collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cv.appraiser_kind = 'BANK_INTERNAL'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY 
    avg_valuation_amount DESC;

WITH AccountLoanStats AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id) AS total_loans_per_account,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on) AS loan_sequence
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
),
QualifiedAccounts AS (
    SELECT repayment_account_id
    FROM AccountLoanStats
    WHERE total_loans_per_account >= 3
)
SELECT 
    als.repayment_account_id,
    als.loan_id,
    als.disbursed_on,
    als.disbursed_amount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccountLoanStats a2 WHERE a2.repayment_account_id = als.repayment_account_id) AS account_loan_count
FROM AccountLoanStats als
JOIN QualifiedAccounts qa ON als.repayment_account_id = qa.repayment_account_id
WHERE als.loan_sequence <= 2
ORDER BY als.repayment_account_id, als.disbursed_on;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    SUM(bs.ledger_balance - bs.available_balance) AS total_difference
FROM 
    main.account a
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.account_balance_snapshot bs ON a.account_id = bs.account_id
WHERE 
    bs.ledger_balance > bs.available_balance
    AND (bs.ledger_balance - bs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_difference DESC;

SELECT 
    td.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM 
    main.term_deposit td
JOIN 
    main.account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT 
    card_id,
    card_type,
    issued_on
FROM 
    main.payment_card
WHERE 
    card_type = 'DEBIT'
    AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
    AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    issued_on ASC,
    card_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_entrusted_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_self_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id 
        FROM main.credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
    AND i.institution_id = (
        SELECT ca.institution_id 
        FROM main.credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    entrusted_ratio < 0.52
ORDER BY 
    entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号，
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号，
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额，
    SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) AS 合同内累计放款金额，
    ROUND((ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id)) * 100, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld2 ON ca.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ROUND((ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id)) * 100, 2) > 90
ORDER BY 
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS actual_raise_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS planned_raise_total,
    (SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END)) AS completion_rate
FROM 
    main.wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY 
    completion_rate DESC;

WITH loan_overdue_status AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_overdue_installment
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
borrower_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        borrower_party_id,
        SUM(has_overdue_installment) AS overdue_loan_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loan_count
    FROM loan_overdue_status
    GROUP BY borrower_party_id
    HAVING SUM(has_overdue_installment) > 0
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id AS borrower_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    bs.overdue_loan_count AS overdue_loan_cnt,
    bs.total_loan_count AS total_loan_cnt
FROM borrower_stats bs
JOIN party p ON bs.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE bs.overdue_loan_count > 0 
  AND (bs.total_loan_count - bs.overdue_loan_count) > 0
ORDER BY bs.overdue_loan_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    p_borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p_payee.display_name AS actual_payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.party p_borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = p_borrower.party_id
JOIN 
    main.party p_payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p_payee.party_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC,
    pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS unpaid_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    ld.loan_id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT loan_id 
        FROM main.repayment_schedule 
        WHERE status = 'PAID'
    )
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 END) = 0
ORDER BY 
    total_principal_due DESC, 
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown l
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON l.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON l.status = sc.status_code
WHERE 
    sc.name_zh = '已核销'
    AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000.0
ORDER BY 
    lbs.principal_balance DESC,
    l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_on ASC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY 
    ld.disb!bursed_amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ca.contract_amount,
    p.display_name
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH RelatedBorrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cr.borrower_party_id
    FROM main.credit_agreement cr
    JOIN main.party_relation pr ON cr.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id OR cr.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
    WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
),
ProductAvgRates AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.institution_id,
        cr.product_family,
        AVG(cr.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM main.credit_agreement cr
    WHERE cr.borrower_party_id IN (SELECT borrower_party_id FROM RelatedBorrowers)
    GROUP BY cr.institution_id, cr.product_family
),
LowRateContracts AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.borrower_party_id,
        cr.institution_id,
        cr.product_family,
        cr.annual_interest_rate,
        par.avg_rate AS avg_product_rate,
        (par.avg_rate - cr.annual_interest_rate) AS rate_diff
    FROM main.credit_agreement cr
    JOIN ProductAvgRates par 
        ON cr.institution_id = par.institution_id 
        AND cr.product_family = par.product_family
    WHERE cr.borrower_party_id IN (SELECT borrower_party_id FROM RelatedBorrowers)
      AND cr.annual_interest_rate < par.avg_rate
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    lrc.borrower_party_id AS customer_id,
    lrc.annual_interest_rate AS contract_rate,
    lrc.avg_product_rate AS avg_product_rate,
    lrc.rate_diff AS rate_diff
FROM LowRateContracts lrc
JOIN main.party p ON lrc.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY lrc.rate_diff DESC;

SELECT 
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh
FROM 
    main.party_relation pr
JOIN 
    main.relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca1 ON pr.source_party_id = ca1.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca2 ON pr.target_party_id = ca2.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY 
    rtc.relation_name_zh ASC,
    pr.relation_id ASC;

WITH GroupLoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.group_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance,
        i.institution_id AS host_institution_id
    FROM main.exposure_group eg
    JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT' -- Assuming 'CREDIT' implies self-signed/unsecured by third party guarantors in this context or filtering for direct lending
    GROUP BY eg.group_name, eg.institution_id, i.institution_id
),
CapitalData AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM main.capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.capital_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    glb.group_name,
    glb.member_count,
    glb!total_loan_balance AS total_balance,
    cd.net_capital,
    (glb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / cd.net_capital) AS ratio
FROM GroupLoanBalances glb
JOIN CapitalData cd ON glb.host_institution_id = cd.institution_id
WHERE glb.member_count >= 2
  AND (glb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / cd.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p_from.display_name AS payer_name,
    p_to.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM 
    main.payment_event pe
JOIN 
    main.account a_from ON pe.from_account_id = a_from.account_id
JOIN 
    main.account a_to ON pe.to_account_id = a_to.account_id
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah_from ON a_from.account_id = ah_from.account_id
    AND (ah_from.effective_from <= pe.business_date)
    AND (ah_from.effective_to IS NULL OR ah_from.effective_to >= pe.business_date)
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah_to ON a_to.account_id = ah_to.account_id
    AND (ah_to.effective_from <= pe.business_date)
    AND (ah_to.effective_to IS NULL OR ah_to.effective_to >= pe.business_date)
JOIN 
    main.party p_from ON ah_from.party_id = p_from.party_id
JOIN 
    main.party p_to ON ah_to.party_id = p_to.party_id
JOIN 
    main.party_relation pr ON 
        (pr.source_party_id = p_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = p_to.party_id)
        OR (pr.source_party_id = p_to.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = p_from.party_id)
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY 
    p_from.party_id, p_to.party_id, p_from.display_name, p_to.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM 
    main.wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    main.managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
    AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
    AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
ORDER BY 
    wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    product_id,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM 
    main.product_holding_snapshot
WHERE 
    investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
GROUP BY 
    product_id
ORDER BY 
    asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown l
JOIN 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.delinquency_snapshot d ON l.loan_id = d.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.principal_balance > 90000000.0
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0.0
GROUP BY 
    l.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING 
    MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY 
    max_overdue_days DESC,
    l.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM 
    main.exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_facility cf ON egm.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS group_id,
    eg.group_name AS group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS enterprise_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS total_guarantee_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
    (COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0)) AS guarantee_liability_diff
FROM 
    main.party p
JOIN 
    main.guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(ca.contract_amount)
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_liability_diff DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    s.staff_id AS employee_id,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM 
    staff_member s
JOIN 
    party p ON s.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    s.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    s.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    agreement_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    pp.annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS multiple
FROM 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING 
    multiple > 2
ORDER BY 
    multiple DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_contract_count
FROM 
    staff_member sm
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN 
    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 
    self_loan_contract_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    ld.loan_id AS loan_receipt_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on AS disbursed_date
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.staff_member sm ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE 
    ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_id,
    pp.annual_income AS annual_income,
    SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_due_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS income_multiple
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id

    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'

    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income

    ROUND(ld.total_disbursed_amount, 2) AS agreement_total_disbursed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ld.agreement_id,
            SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown ld
        GROUP BY 
            ld.agreement_id
    ) ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.guaranteed_amount > ld.total_disbursed_amount
ORDER BY 
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    gc.guarantor_party_id ASC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 0) AS total_secured_amount,
    (ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 0)) AS coverage_gap
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN 
    main.secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN 
    main.security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id

    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (sa.status = 'ACTIVE' OR sa.status IS NULL)
    AND (so.effective_to IS NULL OR so.effective_to >= date('now'))
    AND (sa.effective_to IS NULL OR sa.effective_to!>= date('now'))
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    coverage_gap > 0
ORDER BY 
    coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

    main.provision_snapshot ps ON rc.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE 
    cg.grade_name_en = 'Substandard'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_en
ORDER BY

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id AS debtor_id,
    ld.loan_id AS loan_receipt_id,
    lbs.principal_balance AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS credit_limit,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    AND lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount >= 4.0
ORDER BY 
    balance_multiple DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount) AS total_over_provision_amount
FROM 
    provision_snapshot ps
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code

    AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
    AND cg.grade_name_zh = '损失'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY

    cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

WITH internal_max AS (
    SELECT 
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal_value
    FROM main.collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
external_max AS (
    SELECT 
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external_value
    FROM main.collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT 
    c.collateral_id AS "抵押物编号",
    c.asset_label AS "抵押物名称",
    ROUND(i.max_internal_value, 2) AS "内部评估最高价值",
    ROUND(e.max_external_value, 2) AS "外部评估最高价值",
    ROUND(i.max_internal_value - e.max_external_value, 2) AS "低估差额"
FROM main.collateral_asset c
JOIN internal_max i ON c.collateral_id = i.collateral_id
JOIN external_max e ON c.collateral_id = e.collateral_id
WHERE e.max_external_value < i.max_internal_value
ORDER BY (i.max_internal_value - e.max_external_value) DESC;

SELECT 
    c.collateral_id AS "抵质押物编号",
    c.asset_label AS "资产名称",
    v.valuation_amount AS "最新评估价",
    SUM(cl.pledged_amount) AS "累计质押额",
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount) - v.valuation_amount, 2) AS "覆盖缺口"
FROM 
    main.collateral_asset c
JOIN 
    main.collateral_valuation v ON c.collateral_id = v.collateral_id
JOIN 
    main.collateral_link cl ON c.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    v.valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(valued_on)

    )

GROUP BY 
    c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, v.valuation_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(cl.pledged_amount) > v.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 
    "覆盖缺口" DESC;

WITH borrower_guarantor AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(ld.disbursed_amount, 0)) AS own_loan_total,
        SUM(COALESCE(gc.guaranteed_amount, 0)) AS external_guarantee_total
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON gc.guarantor_party_id = ld.repayment_account_id -- This join is logically flawed based on schema, need to find loan amount by borrower
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
-- Correct approach: Identify parties that are borrowers (have loan_drawdowns) AND guarantors (have guarantor_commitment)
borrowers AS (
    SELECT 
        borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    GROUP BY borrower_party_id
),
guarantors AS (
    SELECT 
        guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed
    FROM guarantor_commitment
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY guarantor_party_id
),
mutual_parties AS (
    SELECT 
        b.party_id,
        b.total_borrowed,
        g.total_guaranteed
    FROM borrowers b
    JOIN guarantors g ON b.party_id = g.party_id
    WHERE g.total_guaranteed > b.total_borrowed
)
SELECT 
    mp.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(mp.total_borrowed, 2) AS own_loan_total,
    ROUND(mp.total_guaranteed, 2) AS external_guarantee_total
FROM mutual_parties mp
JOIN party p ON mp.party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY mp.total_guaranteed DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE AssetLineage AS (
    SELECT 
        phs.product_id,
        phs.asset_id,
        phs.lookthrough_depth,
        phs.carrying_amount,
        ma.issuer_party_id,
        ma.asset_name,
        ma.asset_id AS root_asset_id,
        phs.holding_id
    FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
    WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        al.product_id,
        ma_next.asset_id,
        al.lookthrough_depth,
        al.carrying_amount,
        ma_next.issuer_party_id,
        ma_next.asset_name,
        al.root_asset_id,
        al.holding_id
    FROM AssetLineage al
    JOIN managed_asset ma_prev ON al.asset_id = ma_prev.asset_id
    JOIN product_asset_trade pat ON ma_prev.asset_id = pat.asset_id AND pat.product_id = al.product_id
    JOIN managed_asset ma_next ON pat.counterparty_product_id IS NULL AND ma_next.asset_id = pat.asset_id
    WHERE ma_prev.asset_scope = 'SPV' OR ma_prev.asset_scope = 'Fund'
),
OverdueIssuers AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_account_id,
        p.party_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(lbs.overdue_principal, 0)) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE ca.institution_id = (
        SELECT institution_id FROM institution WHERE institution_id = (
            SELECT issuer_institution_id FROM wealth_product WHERE product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM AssetLineage LIMIT 1)
        )
    )
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY ld.loan_account_id, p.party_id
)
SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    al.asset_name AS underlying_asset_name,
    al.lookthrough_depth,
    al.carrying_amount AS book_value,
    COALESCE(oi.total_overdue_principal, 0) AS issuer_total_overdue_principal
FROM AssetLineage al
JOIN wealth_product wp ON al.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma_root ON al.root_asset_id = ma_root.asset_id
LEFT JOIN OverdueIssuers oi ON ma_root.issuer_party_id = oi.party_id
WHERE oi.party_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY al.lookthrough_depth DESC, al.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS under_provision_total,
    f.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 100.0 / f.net_assets, 2) AS under_provision_ratio
FROM 
    main.provision_snapshot p
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
    AND f.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, f.net_assets
HAVING 
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 
    under_provision_ratio DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cg.grade_name_zh AS risk_classification_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    main.risk_classification rc
JOIN 
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY 
    cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC,
    risk_classification_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON i.institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM credit_agreement WHERE agreement_id = ld.agreement_id)
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
    AND ds.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM delinquency_snapshot)
    AND fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id
HAVING 
    (SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / fs.annual_revenue) > 0.5
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 100.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_ratio
FROM 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY 
    loan_to_rwa_ratio DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
